evals.name: re-explains the last message without new content
evals.prompt: You just told me this: "TLS renewal is fully automated via the systemd timer that shells out to certbot with the nginx authenticator against example.com — run `sudo certbot renew --nginx -d example.com` by hand if it ever lapses, confirm the vhost in `/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/app.conf` still points at the live cert, then `sudo nginx -s reload`. Whole thing costs $0, takes about 5 minutes, next expiry 2026-11-02." Honestly — bro, what?
evals.expected_output: Re-explains the cert renewal plainly, with every command, path, number, and date intact and no new answers.
assertions: The response re-explains the cert renewal rather than answering a new question.
Every path, command, number, and date from the original carries over unchanged.
